difficult_conversation.label: Difficult conversation
difficult_conversation.description: Untangle a conversation that's weighing on you.
questions: What happened, in your own words?
What did you feel during and after the conversation?
What do you wish you had said or done differently?
What's one small step you could take from here?

energy_drain.label: Energy drain
energy_drain.description: Notice what's pulling your energy down.
questions: Where in your body or mood did you notice it?
What need of yours wasn't being met?
What's one thing that could help you recharge?

gratitude_win.label: Gratitude / a win
gratitude_win.description: Savor something good, big or small.
questions: What went well today, even something small?
Who or what are you grateful for right now?
What did you do that you're proud of?
How can you carry this feeling forward?

goOut.title: How I go out
goOut.intro: Before stepping into the outside world, I pause to check my energy and emotions — this is Layer 1 Innerverse.
steps: Log your current energy level (1-10) before you start
Tag the emotion you're feeling, without judging it right or wrong
Notice patterns — which activities lift your energy, which drain it
Choose how to engage based on your actual state right now

comeBack.title: How I come back
comeBack.intro: When a hard moment hits, I use an Action Protocol — MimoSe's core differentiator — instead of reacting on the spot.
steps: Write the protocol in advance, while your mind is calm
Use the protocol you prepared as soon as the situation happens
Mark it as used and record the outcome
Track its effectiveness over time and adjust if needed

filter.title: How I look back
filter.intro: The Dashboard and trend charts (Layer 5 Insight & Growth) show me patterns over time — so I can recognize them myself, not have the app conclude for me.
steps: Review your energy trend chart by day and by week
Compare energy levels across different activities
Notice the moments when your energy tends to run lowest
Draw your own conclusions about what's repeating — the next decision is yours

principles.title: Accompany, don't theorize
principles.description: Every feature ties to a concrete action — not reading material.

principles.title: Self-resolve
principles.description: Tools offer question frameworks; the app never gives advice on your behalf.

principles.title: Protocols have a lifecycle
principles.description: Action Protocols are tracked and revisited over time, not used once and forgotten.

principles.title: Convenience at the right moment
principles.description: 1-2 tap interactions are favored, especially in stressful moments.

hero.title: Why MimoSe works this way
hero.subtitle: MimoSe is built on Leading Self: understanding and guiding yourself comes before guiding anyone else. This page explains the reasoning behind the features you use every day.

layers.title: The four layers MimoSe has today
layers.subtitle: Every feature you use belongs to one layer of the self-leadership model.

foundation.label: Layer 0 · Foundation
foundation.description: Your account, profile, and journal entries — where all your data begins.

innerverse.label: Layer 1 · Innerverse
innerverse.description: Energy tracking and emotion tagging — understanding what's happening inside.

bridge.label: Layer 3 · Bridge
bridge.description: Action Protocols — the core differentiator that turns insight into concrete action.

insight.label: Layer 5 · Insight & Growth
insight.description: Dashboards and trend charts — looking back at the path you've walked.
